convert_glfw_key_to_keycode: use MagnumKeyConverter.convert_key to map a GLFW Application.Key to a KeyCode enum value
convert_glfw_button_to_mousebutton: use MagnumKeyConverter.convert_mouse_button to map a GLFW Application.Pointer to a MouseButton enum value
check_keycode_membership: check if an integer is a valid KeyCode by using the in operator with KeyCode
check_mousebutton_membership: check if an integer is a valid MouseButton by using the in operator with MouseButton
check_xrbutton_membership: check if an integer is a valid XRButton by using the in operator with XRButton
